_comment: 2018 JetHT counterpart of dijet_mg_pythia8_2018_rho_skim.json (2026-07-25). Data fills only the `reco` table plus events/alljets; `matched`/`gen` are booked but stay empty, and for data final_seq == recoTot_seq so `reco` means the same thing as in MC. rho_skim10 matches the MC prescale so data/MC compare bin-for-bin. Run via scripts/run_dijet_skim_split.py --bins Run2018A Run2018B Run2018C Run2018D -- one submit per era for the same 4-core/8-GiB client-reduce reason as the MC HT split.
